notes.title: Era 3 Now in Development!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there!

Been a while, mainly due to me taking a short break after releasing Era 2.
But recently I have begun developing Era 3, so in return here is a sneak peek of the first level.

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667472/41d3e4a1fcd41dc985f7d798e2ee76ba9f5b1fef.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667472/2205936062206d12b9c816262bd4ee79c80f4baa.jpg"][/img]
I'm planning for this Era to be more atmospheric like Era 2, but also contain the open arenas from Era 1, while also pushing the story forward more directly rather than the background storytelling of the first two eras.

Of course, I'm not going to dump 10 minutes of text or cutscenes at you, this is a fast-paced FPS and not even my attention span lasts that long.

Expect more voice work and maybe one or two cutscenes before certain levels (not Boss ones).

Either way, Thank you for Reading and Playing TIME COWBOY![/p]

notes.title: TIME COWBOY Update 1.1a
notes.notes:
Hey there, TIME COWBOY has just been updated to v1.1a!
(Which, in case if you have been out of the loop, released last Thursday)

Here's what has been changed:

- Added more Grapple Points (Green Orbs) to certain maps
- Added a Special Ability to the Crossbow
- Redone the Progress Bar for Specials
- Reworded B-Hop Tutorial
- Added Kill-gate for Era 2 Level 9
- Buffed Torch
- Slightly reworked Era 2 Level 5
- Slightly reworked Era 2 Level 1
- Fixed a bug where players on Yellowbelly would be unable to progress Era 2 Level 1 despite killing all enemies

That is all for today, Thank you for Reading.

notes.title: Demo Patch v1.1b
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there! Apparently there were a couple issues with the last update.
Here's the patch notes:

- Fixed Hole in "Another Hideout"[/p][p]- Made Levels (7 & 8) more easily navigable[/p][p]- Added a popup for when a Door opens[/p][p]- Finally changed the Impact Sprite[/p][p]- Fixed when running out of Bullet Time, Music would not unmuffle[/p][p]- Updated Credits[/p][p]- Included Era 2 Level 1 Teaser[/p][p][/p][p]This'll be the last patch & update for awhile, so thank you to those who played the Demo![/p]

notes.title: Demo v1.1a: Endless Mode + Preformance Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there! Just released a new build for the Demo!
Here's the changelog:

- Included Endless Mode (Unlocks after beating the Demo)[/p][p]- Revamped Enemy animations[/p][p]- Preformance Improvements to Blood Decals & Particles[/p][p]- Fists have a new mechanic similar to 8 Shot 3 Shot[/p][p]- Action Labels no longer appear for Friendly Fire[/p][p]- Projectiles from Enemies now disappear once the Enemy dies[/p][p]- Walljumping now tilts your camera & creates dust particles[/p][p]- Jumping now creates dust particles[/p][p][/p][p]On another note, this is most likely the last update to the Demo.
There is a chance that it'll be updated once the full game drops, but no promises.
[/p][p]Thank you for reading.[/p]
